question: What specific accomplishment arises from ten thousand recitations on the dark fourteenth day?
premises: The recitation count is ten thousand.
The occasion is the dark fourteenth lunar day.
The promised result is accomplishment of speech.
inference: By muttering ten thousand times on the dark fourteenth day, one obtains the accomplishment of speech.
plain_english: By reciting ten thousand times on the dark fourteenth day, he obtains the accomplishment of speech.
